_comment: Overrides run_generative_matrix.py's cloud tier to point at the vLLM server
deployed by src/modal_apps/cloud_tier_server.py, instead of Together AI.
Replace base_url with the URL `modal deploy` prints, then:
The server is deployed unauthenticated, so the key value is ignored -- but
build_layer() refuses to start without the env var set, which is a useful
guard against silently running a billed tier by accident, so it is kept.
Model is Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct because config/layer_energy.yaml already
tabulates that exact model on the cloud tier (1.044 J/token, 4xH100,
optimized batch), keeping confidence and energy referring to one model.
